sources.title: A Door Made of Glass Panels
sources.author: Taryn Elliott
sources.description_and_selection: Slow continuous architectural view of a white internal glazed door with brass handle and a wooden table and vase in the room behind. No people, UI, text or marks. Slight cool white balance can be gently warmed. Clear real internal-door scene, premium domestic atmosphere.
sources.license: Pexels License, free on the individual source page

sources.title: Video of a House Hallway
sources.author: Kindel Media
sources.description_and_selection: Slow walkthrough of a contemporary corridor, light wood floor, warm raking light at left, dark internal door and handle at right. Real architecture, no UI/brand. Darker and moodier than the preferred scene; use only if coherent with the edit.
sources.license: Pexels License, free on the individual source page

sources.title: An Open Door
sources.author: RDNE Stock project
sources.description_and_selection: Portrait close view past an old door handle into a sunny room with an antique chair. Warm and real, but rustic/vintage hardware and vertical format do not match the intended contemporary premium direction.
sources.license: Pexels License, free on the individual source page

sources.title: Person Opening And Closing The Door
sources.author: Nazar Matveichev
sources.description_and_selection: Close detail of hand operating dark wood door handle, then suited person passes. Door lock, cold cast and doorway suggest entrance/access scene rather than warm internal architecture. Useful only as a security-detail backup, not internal-door solution.
sources.license: Pexels License, free on the individual source page
